# Rev-IQ

> Rev-IQ is a commercial and revenue operations resource for software and SaaS leaders — practical frameworks, templates, and advisory support for founders and executives who want revenue that grows in a straight line rather than a rollercoaster.

Rev-IQ publishes a free resource library of frameworks and templates covering revenue growth, operating rhythm, hiring and org design, security posture, AI strategy, leadership, and partnerships for software businesses. Content is written in a direct, editorial, expert-led voice — no fluff, no growth-hacking clichés.

## Flagship frameworks

- [The 5 Levers That Actually Drive SaaS Revenue](https://rev-iq.ai/articles/01-the-5-levers-that-actually-drive-saas-revenue.html): The core operating logic behind SaaS growth — acquisition, conversion, pricing, retention, and expansion — and how to diagnose which lever is the real constraint.
- [Designing a Simple Operating Rhythm for Your SaaS](https://rev-iq.ai/articles/03-designing-a-simple-operating-rhythm-for-your-saas.html): How to turn a project into a business with a weekly/monthly/quarterly review cadence that fits a small team.
- [The Rev-IQ 3-Pillar AI Strategy Framework](https://rev-iq.ai/articles/30-the-rev-iq-3-pillar-ai-strategy-framework.html): A sequencing model for AI adoption in software companies — educate the workforce, operationalise AI internally, then productise it for customers, in that order.
